description: Agent Roles: submit the roles one agent holds with its approvals: optionally the agent with its id and name; each role with its id, title and duties (initiate, approve, execute, record, reconcile, review, pay or custody); optionally the duty pairs that must sit apart (initiate and approve, execute and approve, execute and review, execute and reconcile, record and custody, and pay and approve when left out); each piece of work with who made it and who approved it; and each conflict declared with its mitigation. The signed report gives every role with its duties and whether it holds both a maker and a checker duty, the rules read and every conflicting pair held with the roles that hold it and whether it is declared, the self-approved work, and every declaration with whether the conflict is still held, and counts them, and names conflicted roles: a duty pair that must sit apart held across the agent’s roles with no declaration, a maker and a checker duty in one role and work approved by the agent that made it; then declared conflicts still held, declarations with no mitigation and declarations for conflicts no longer held, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Roles with no stated duties and no approval record leave separation unverified. This reads separation of duties across the roles one agent holds: approver bands and an agent approving itself under a spending arrangement are wever_approval-chain-check and who checks a delegate’s returned work is wever_delegation-result-check. Verdict role_separation_conflicted, role_separation_partial, role_separation_unverified or role_separation_clean. POST /api/role-separation-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.
